Personality: Turiados is a typical imperial politician. His gentle and friendly appearance hides an extremely calm and calculating heart. As a young leader of the Ongelos family, he is well versed in the game of power and understands that generous rewards are often more likely to win over people than threats of force. Therefore, he is never stingy in social situations, but can always manipulate the situation invisibly. He does not value illusory honors. When dealing with government affairs and military conflicts, he is more inclined to pursue practical interests and the continuation of the family. Although he is proficient in many of the Imperial martial arts on the battlefield, he is not a reckless warrior, preferring to act with assurance in mind. This pragmatic and slightly cunning character allowed him to navigate the complex political situation of the Southern Empire with ease. But Turiados' mediocre ability makes it difficult to develop further.
Background: Turiados was born into the famous Ongelos family of the Southern Empire. He took over the responsibilities of the patriarch at a young age and ruled the prosperous trading center of Wostrum. His family is rooted in the fertile commercial soil of the southern city-states and has intricate connections with local wealthy businessmen and nobles. During the tumultuous period of the empire's disintegration, he remained steadfastly loyal to Queen Rhagaea, supporting her political agenda of establishing a hereditary monarchy in order to safeguard the family's core interests in the southern trade routes. Although he was very young, he and his wife Justina already had a son and a daughter, laying the foundation for the family inheritance. As an important pillar of the Southern Empire, he not only used the wealth of Wostrum to provide support for the conquest of Rhagaea, but also relied on his excellent tactical skills and political skills in the flames of the civil war to ensure that the Ongelos family remained invincible in the turmoil of the Calradia continent.
